prompt: Create a highly detailed artistic mixed-media portrait using a realistic young woman as the main subject. Preserve a natural photographic face with soft skin texture, almond brown eyes, full brows, a straight nose, soft pink lips, oval face shape, and long loose chestnut-brown hair with subtle highlights. Place her on the right half of a vertical canvas, shown from mid-torso up, wearing an oversized matte black sweatshirt, shoulders relaxed, head turned slightly left while gazing upward to the left with a calm thoughtful expression. Use a warm vintage parchment background in beige, tan, sepia, charcoal, and burnt orange. Blend photography with watercolor, ink wash, collage, botanical illustration, and aged paper textures. Behind her, create a layered mountain landscape on the left-center: exactly 5 visible jagged mountain peaks with snowy charcoal ridges, misty watercolor foothills, and exactly 6 dark evergreen trees of varying sizes in the lower mountain area. Add a large burnt-orange sun disk behind the mountains near the top center. Include exactly 11 small black bird silhouettes flying around the sun and mountains. Add decorative mixed-media elements: faint handwritten manuscript lines in sepia, black ink splatters, grunge stains, torn-paper washes, subtle grid paper in the top-right and bottom-left corners, thin botanical branches with leaves on the right edge and lower-right foreground, and a few dried floral silhouettes overlapping the sweatshirt. In the lower-left quadrant, add elegant black handwritten script reading exactly: "Be your own muse. The world will adjust." with line breaks arranged like the image. Make the composition feel like a fine-art journal page, dreamy and inspirational, with soft natural lighting on the face, high detail in the hair, painterly edges dissolving into the paper, no frame, no watermark, and no extra text.
